cells.scene: Fresh identical books emerge from a printing press onto a stack, a publisher checks one copy.
A desktop fax machine with paper feeding into the top and a received sheet emerging from the front, blank paper lines only.
A manager hands a disappointed employee a dismissal envelope while the employee carries a small box of personal desk items away.
Three tiny successive house scenes: an old cottage on the left, renovation in middle, modern shop right; the first cottage emphasized blue.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — publish (v.出版): Fresh identical books emerge from a printing press onto a stack, a publisher checks one copy.
TOP RIGHT — fax (n.传真): A desktop fax machine with paper feeding into the top and a received sheet emerging from the front, blank paper lines only.
BOTTOM LEFT — fire (v.解雇): A manager hands a disappointed employee a dismissal envelope while the employee carries a small box of personal desk items away.
BOTTOM RIGHT — originally (ad.起初，原先，从前): Three tiny successive house scenes: an old cottage on the left, renovation in middle, modern shop right; the first cottage emphasized blue.
